x-values.triage: first contact: the summary plus the slowest devices
x-values.devices: which devices failed and why, with the last successful collection, connectivity error and explanation
x-values.platforms: failures by vendor, OS and OS version against all devices of that platform
x-values.changes: new, recovered and still-failing devices against the previous snapshot
x-values.exceptions: collector exceptions and the devices they hit
x-values.slow: per-device collection time, slowest commands, collectors, slots held against device time
x-values.cloud: cloud collection failures by account and region

failure.description: (view slow: keep only rebalance moves of devices with this connection type, such as SSH or TELNET)

limit.description: (view slow: also the number of rebalance moves listed, default 50)

compare_to_snapshot_id.description: view slow: a second snapshot to set beside the one asked about (total device time, parallelism, per-device figures, and per device type and connection)
